description: Roll up to six dice with 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 or 20 sides. Watch the animated faces settle, see the total instantly, and review a history of your recent rolls.

faqs.a: It uses your browser's built-in random number generator (Math.random), which is fine for games and fun but not for security or gambling purposes.
faqs.q: How random are the dice rolls?

faqs.a: You can roll between 1 and 6 dice at a time. For more dice, roll in batches — every roll is added to the history list.
faqs.q: Can I roll more than 6 dice at once?

faqs.a: For the classic 6-sided die you see unicode dice faces; for other die sizes the rolled number is shown on each die instead.
faqs.q: Why do some dice show numbers instead of pips?

howto: Choose how many dice to roll (1 to 6).
Pick the number of sides: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 or 20.
Click "Roll Dice" to see the animated result and the total.
Scroll the history list to review your previous rolls.
title: Dice Roller
